relationships.evidence_quote: firing rates were increased while the rheobase decreased in GlumPOA neurons incubated in both 0.3 μM and 1 μM testosterone propionate compared with the GlumPOA vehicle controls

relationships.subject: testosterone
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrate that testosterone, rather than estrogen, mediates sex-specific contextual pain hypersensitivity.

relationships.subject: Glu mPOA neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: optical activation of GlumPOA neurons resulted in both pain hypersensitivity and place avoidance in both maleDC and femaleDC mice

relationships.subject: GABA mPOA neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: optical activation of GABAmPOA neurons could indeed reverse contextual pain hypersensitivity in maleSC mice compared with mCherry-infected control mice

key_findings: Elevated free testosterone drives male-specific contextual pain hypersensitivity via hyperactive mPOA glutamatergic neurons.
Testosterone propionate induces the phenotype in females; castration abolishes it in males.
